Why we built it

We learn web development by building websites with different purposes, from product presentation to information and visual storytelling.

02

What we made

SkyRing explores an interactive 3D product, TitanGOAT uses video controlled by scrolling, and a website about Olomouc focuses on information and presentation.

These self-initiated studies demonstrate techniques we can bring to client work.

03

Put these skills into practice through focused website briefs and feedback from clients.
